newsitem.title: UK: LME metals barely changed in evening session.
newsitem.headline: LME metals barely changed in evening session.

text.p: Prices on the London Metal Exchange (LME) were barely changed to easier from kerb levels during Tuesday's late session.
Nickel steadied after paring some of its swingeing gains from Monday while copper came off its highs after posting some sharp rises.

At 1900 GMT, nickel was indicated at $7,830/$7,860 barely changed having seemingly over-extended itself with a 26-percent rise since the beginning of the year to a peak of $8,120 per tonne this morning, analysts said.
On Monday, nickel broke above the $8,000 level.

Copper edged a little easier to be indicated at $2,342/$2,344 against a kerb close of $2,349/$2,350 and aluminium was barely changed at $1,642/$1,645 having lost sight of a fresh peak at $1,663 and sinking below the $1,651 chart point.
